title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0195
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0195
Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in ShowDoc
Original Issue Date:April     17, 2026
Severity Rating: CRITICAL
Software Affected
ShowDoc versions prior to 2.8.7
Overview
Remote Code Execution vulnerability has been identified in ShowDoc which could allow a remote attacker to upload arbitrary files on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
All end-user organizations and individuals using ShowDoc.
Risk Assessment:
High risk of remote code execution, unauthorized access and complete system compromise.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for full system takeover, unauthorized access, remote code execution.
Description
ShowDoc is an open-source web-based document management and collaboration service.
Remote Code Execution vulnerability exists in ShowDoc due to unrestricted file upload that stems from improper validation of file extension, which could allow an attacker to upload arbitrary PHP files and achieve remote code execution on the server with specially crafted requests.
Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to gain unauthorized access and/or execute arbitrary code on the targeted system.
Solution
Apply appropriate updates as mentioned by the vendor:
https://thehackernews.com/2026/04/showdoc-rce-flaw-cve-2025-0520-actively.html
